 # Purpose

This R Markdown document demonstrates a simple analysis using synthetic data. No real or personal data is used.

# Inputs

The analysis uses a small set of synthetic numeric values.

```{r}
data <- c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50)
data
```

# Analysis

The following code calculates the mean of the synthetic data.

```{r}
mean_value <- mean(data)
mean_value
```

# Outputs

The output shows the calculated mean of the synthetic dataset.

```{r}
summary(data)
```

# Conclusion

This example demonstrates how R Markdown can combine documentation, R code, and analysis results in one file.
